scenario: Two modules bind the same control point with contradictory failure modes; the conflict must be surfaced with both sources named, never auto-resolved.
when: the two modules are composed onto the control point

reasons: modules 'secret-scan' and 'fast-path' declare contradictory failure modes on 'before-tool-use'
both modules and their zones are named in the report
must_not: resolve by load order, file order, or last-writer-wins
let the project-zone module weaken the organization-zone failure mode
disable either module silently to make composition succeed
